item.title: Swans covered in oil rescued from a Rushcliffe pond
item.description: The Environment Agency (EA) was called after residents found oil in a pond near the River Trent in Radcliffe-on-Trent on Saturday. The EA said officers believed approximately 10 litres of oil was spilled from a container into the pond. item.description: Two men were treated in hospital after a collision involving a car and a van on the A46. item.description: Nottingham Light Night is set to return for its 18th year on Friday 6 and Saturday 7 February 2026.
